framework.description: Research Constitution for the Constrained Evolutionary Search Swarm role-specialized stabilization component. Defines the objective 5-metric evaluation harness, fixed research budgets per job, and keep/discard discipline with provenance (experience genome forks via Genome.fork + promotion with lineage, or revert). Directly consumable by HealingFactor, GridEngine background research threads, and supervisor daily_consolidation / healing phases. All in pure AgentDrive language.
framework.decision_policy: if overall_goodness >= threshold and resilience_lift >= 0.04 then keep_promote_with_lineage (fork + provenance) else if low or exhausted then discard_revert (record provenance, quarantine candidate)
framework.provenance_requirements: All keep decisions attach to GenomeProvenance.lineage as 'harness_promoted_fork'; discard records revert_note. Results emitted as experience-observation / daily-present / healing_attempt for sibling swarm fusion on stabilization-wave-20260531 drive.
